final_message:
Fixed BUG-014 in `helpdesk/model.py`.

Removed the urgency-based confirmation bypass. Cancellation requests now require the confirmation step regardless of wording; replying “yes” on the next turn still cancels the order.

Validation:
- `python -m qa run cases/bug-014.yaml --runs 10`: both cases passed **10/10**.
- `python -m pytest -q`: **9 passed**.

No tests, cases, or tool permission checks were changed.
